experiment: CDIP validity check, 1024 balanced groups, deterministic permutation null, 1000 repeats
purpose: Pressure-test whether the aggregate multi-buoy stigmergy surplus survives a null that preserves per-series observer score distributions while breaking non-anchor cross-buoy timing alignment within each window.

method.detector_inputs: Agnostic spectral observer outputs only: frozen/sliding residual surprise, conditional drift, state drift, source identity.
method.null_description: For each repeat, the first series in a window remains anchored and non-anchor series keep their observed scores but receive a deterministic within-series permutation of anchor indexes. This preserves per-series score distributions and window geometry while disrupting cross-buoy timing coherence.

comparison.interpretation: The permutation null is a stricter validity check than the cyclic shifted-null control. The observed aggregate still exceeded all 1000 unique permutation-null totals, but the delta decreased by about 9.2%, so some surplus is sensitive to the null definition while substantial coherent structure remains.

reporting_caution.normal_theory_p: Do not present observed_total_z_normal_p_one_sided as evidentiary p-value. Treat observed_total_z as standardized effect size and report empirical shifted/permutation-null exceedance with its floor.
